units: Jon. IV, 10),] to protect, spare, have consideration for (with על).
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 12:5">Neg. XII, 5</cite> <he>אם כך חָסָה התורה וכ׳</he> if the Law has such consideration for man’s property of small value &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 14a:15">Sot. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>אם ככה ח׳ וכ׳</he> if the Law made such considerate provision for those transgressing &c.
